title: SGD orchestrated-skill exit report
description: The one machine-readable exit-report shape every orchestrated SGD skill emits at the end of a run — consumed by orchestrators (team-pipeline, pr-monitor, issue-swarm) to decide the next move. See skills/exit-report/SKILL.md for the contract, emission channels, and mappings from legacy shapes.

skill.description: Emitting skill's identifier, without the plugin prefix.

runId.description: Stable identifier for this run — dispatcher-provided when the skill was fanned out (so the orchestrator can correlate), otherwise self-minted as <skill>-<primary item>-<ISO start time>.

itemsProcessed.description: Count of work items this run acted on. Usually outcomes.length, but may exceed it when items were examined and dismissed without a reportable outcome.

outcomes.description: One entry per work item the run acted on (PR, issue, lane, repo). Empty when the run found nothing actionable (pair with stopReason "queue-empty").

stopReason.description: Why the run ended — every loop's stop condition maps onto exactly one of these (see the loops reference: goal met, bound hit, no-progress/thrash, budget, user stop).

followUps.description: Follow-up work filed (not merely suggested) during the run — tracking issues for deferred findings, tech debt, or uncovered pre-existing bugs.

questionsPerRun.description: Spec-quality metric (SPEC-093, #1235): count of SPEC-093 tier-b decision-journal entries across all lanes this run — ambiguities the agent resolved via the most-reversible-option fallback rather than a spec decision rule. Target trend → 0. Present on team-pipeline runs under --unattended (or SGD_UNATTENDED=1); 0 on attended runs. A value above 0 names which specs lack a '## Decision rules & defaults' table. See docs/specs/README.md.

item.description: Stable key for the work item, as <kind>:<id>.

status.description: Terminal state of this item. success = goal reached; partial = real progress, goal not reached; blocked = structurally blocked, needs a human decision; thrashing = retry bound hit with no progress (do not re-dispatch); failed = attempted and did not succeed; skipped = deliberately not attempted (ineligible, claimed elsewhere, deduped).

detail.description: One-line human-readable note. Mandatory in spirit for blocked/thrashing/failed: state the blocking condition and the recommended next action.

pr.description: PR number this outcome produced or acted on, when applicable.

issue.description: Issue number this outcome implements or acts on, when applicable.

commits.description: Commits produced for this item, as "<sha> <subject>".

labelState.description: Final merge-gate label state of a reviewed PR at run exit (issue #855, emitted by pr-review). A well-behaved review exits at pr-reviewed (passed) or none (failed/released/advisory/no-op); labelState: pr-reviewing means the run exited while still holding the claim — a violated termination contract the orchestrator must re-dispatch or nudge. Optional: only outcomes for a claimed pr-review carry it.

ref.description: Reference to the filed follow-up — "#N" for same-repo, "owner/repo#N" cross-repo, or a URL.
